items.title: Heart, hope and a steely determination: Dolly Parton's musical legacy
items.description: BBC music correspondent Mark Savage looks back on the legacy of the "irreplaceable" late singer.

items.title: Door was locked at Pakistan hospital where fire killed 14 babies, witnesses say
items.description: A hospital official told the BBC that the door to the ward was not locked, but manned with security guards, to protect the babies.

items.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
items.description: The latest escalation in an ongoing trade war between the US and Canada will see new levies on goods from steel to furniture, fresh tuna and makeup.

items.title: Radiation link in flight attendant's breast cancer, French court finds
items.description: Former Air France stewardess Sophie Lainault has had her cancer recognised as an occupational disease.

items.title: Far-right Israeli lawmaker damages Palestinian memorial with sledgehammer
items.description: Zvi Sukkot's actions have drawn widespread condemnation, including from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

items.title: Libyan who was cleared after Lockerbie bombing trial dies aged 70
items.description: A Facebook post by Libyan Airlines announced the death of Al Amin Khalifah Fhimah and expressed the company's condolences to his family.

items.title: German airport worker dies of malaria after 'mosquito arrives on plane'
items.description: Five other airport workers are also receiving treatment following the rare outbreak at German's busiest airport.

items.title: China advises its citizens to leave Taiwan ally Eswatini over 'security risks'
items.description: Eswatini is one of 12 countries, and the only one in Africa, that has diplomatic relations with Taiwan.

items.title: Indian jewellery ad pulled after backlash over actor's outfit
items.description: Kriti Sanon has defended the ad in which she was seen celebrating the upcoming Hindu festival of Rakhi.

items.title: Guinea's president dismisses 173 soldiers, including coup ally, for desertion
items.description: It is thought to be part of efforts to consolidate the former coup leader's control.

items.title: Germany's Merz warns attackers will 'pay price' after drone incident
items.description: A drone attack on Leipzig Airport highlights the "very real threat" faced by the country, the German chancellor says.

items.title: Trump says all mines cleared from Strait of Hormuz
items.description: Iran has closed the vital waterway since the beginning of the conflict causing wild fluctuations in oil prices worldwide.

items.title: Musk's SpaceX to build $100bn launch facility in Louisiana
items.description: It will be the firm's biggest site yet and aims to send rockets to space in 2029.

items.title: Bodies found on S Korean holiday island as missing persons scandal deepens
items.description: A police sergeant has been arrested following accusations that he lied to victims' families and prematurely closed missing persons cases.

items.title: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
items.description: Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft travelled to Russia from the US via Latvia on Tuesday.

items.title: Brain disease in dead NFL players 'higher than previously shown'
items.description: A new study says at least one in four ex-NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had a degenerative brain disease but the true figure could be much higher.

items.title: Canada's retaliation tests the limit of American power under Trump
items.description: The president is using US dominance to challenge allies and enemies alike - but both Canada and Iran have found ways to fight back.

items.title: As Ukraine hits Russia's refineries, Russia targets Ukraine's petrol pumps
items.description: Fuel companies are urging customers not to linger at the pumps after a wave of deadly attacks.

items.title: Watch Nashville fans lay flowers in tribute to Dolly Parton
items.description: The BBC's Helena Humphrey is outside the Country Music Hall of Fame where fans gathered to mourn Dolly Parton.

items.title: Chinese teens are turning to mind-numbing drugs to 'run away from reality'
items.description: Students are seeking prescription drugs because they fear failure, a teen tells the BBC.
